creativeThesis: The same business told as a field record rather than a drawing sheet: dark ground, one column, oversized light type, full-bleed inverted plates. It exists to prove the platform imposes no house style.
antiTargets: Condensed uppercase labels used as structure

typography.intent: One light display weight at large size, doing the work the flagship's condensed labels do.
principles: Light weights only; the flagship is semibold.
No uppercase tracked labels as structure.
Long measure, generous leading.

colour.intent: Inverted: dark ground, warm signal accent.
principles: Ground is near-black, not grey.
One accent, used for action and emphasis only.
Contrast meets WCAG AA on the dark ground.

composition.intent: A single centred column with full-bleed media interruptions. No grid.
principles: No visible grid at all.
Media breaks the measure; text never does.
Rules are replaced by space.

imagery.intent: The same plates, inverted and cropped panoramic so they read as photography-scale interruptions.
principles: Full-bleed, never framed.
Inverted for the dark ground.
Panoramic on desktop, taller on mobile so the drawing survives.
No borders on navigation.
Accent on hover and focus.
Targets at least 44px.
This variation ships no motion at all.
It proves the Signature is client-owned, not a platform feature.
motion.reducedMotionIntent: Nothing to reduce: there is no motion in any mode.

responsive.intent: The single column is already the mobile layout; only media crops change.
principles: Media takes a taller crop on mobile.
Fact rows wrap rather than scroll.
No layout is hidden at any width.

signatureIntent.name: None
signatureIntent.purpose: This variation deliberately declares no Signature, proving a Signature is a client choice rather than something the platform imposes.
